answer: A synchronized pseudonym party stops attempts to forge many identities. At a beacon-chosen time, applicants join a live video ceremony in random groups of five, speak a fresh phrase, and cross-attest in real time. A mirror check compares ephemeral similarity signals across groups during that ceremony only, flagging anyone appearing twice. K fakes need K distinct people present the same minute, plus a 20 POA bond each, locked 4 epochs and slashed on duplicates. Like yarrow, each stem must be planted separately. Limits: time zones, accessibility, and hired stand-ins; add random re-checks.
